INSTRUCTIONS FOR THE PSYCH TEST

Greetings of the Day.

Today you will undergo a set of psychological tests designed to understand your natural way of thinking, feeling, acting, and dealing with situations. These tests are not school examinations and there are no fixed right or wrong answers. You need not compare yourself with others. Every individual is likely to react in his/her own way.

Do not try to project an artificial personality or write what you think the Board wants to see. The tests are designed to study spontaneity and consistency. Therefore, your first natural response is usually more useful than an overthought response. The Psych Test battery consists of four different tests 1. Thematic Apperception Test (TAT) 2. Word Association Test (WAT) 3. Situation Reaction Test (SRT) 4. Self Description

Instructions for each test will be flashed on the screen for 3 minutes prior commencement of that test. Read the instructions carefully. They are self-explanatory. Manage your time sensibly and attempt every test with full involvement. Even if one response does not go well, do not carry it forward mentally into the next test.

Remain calm, write legibly, and express yourself freely. We are not searching for perfection; we are trying to understand your personality.

All the best.
THEMATIC APPERCEPTION TEST (TAT)

This is a test of your imagination. In this test you will be shown several pictures one after the other. What you are required to do is write a story around the picture and the characters shown in the picture, covering a. What led to the situation (PAST) b. What is going on (PRESENT) c. What will be the outcome (FUTURE) You will also describe the feelings, thoughts and actions of the characters shown in the picture. In total you will be shown 11 pictures, and 12th picture will be a blank slide wherein you are free to imagine a picture of your own choice and then write a story around that picture which you have imagined. Each picture will be shown for 30 seconds, and you will be given 04 minutes to write the story Once the picture goes off the screen, you may start writing the story for four minutes and once four minutes are over the next picture will automatically be flashed on the screen. INSTRUCTIONS FOR TAT

TAT PICTURE 12 (BLANK SLIDE)

Imagine a picture of your own choice and prepare to write a story around it.

STOP WRITING!

Prepare for a short break.
WORD ASSOCIATION TEST (WAT)

This is another test of imagination. In this test, you will be shown several words one after the other. What you are required to do is, express the first thought or idea that comes to your mind on seeing a particular word in the form of a sentence. You may or may not use the word, to express your thought or idea. Each word will be shown for 15 seconds. Within that time, you must see the word and record your response against the relevant column number. In case no thought or idea comes to your mind on seeing a particular word, leave that column blank and proceed to the next. In total you will be shown 60 words, and you will be given time to turn over the page after 20th and 40th word. INSTRUCTIONS FOR WAT
SITUATION REACTION TEST (SRT)

In this test several situations are presented to you. You are required to write how you would feel, think and act in each of those situations.

You will be given 30 minutes to attempt 60 situations. INSTRUCTIONS FOR SRT

In this test several situations are presented to you. You are required to write how you would feel, think and act in each of those situations.

You will be given 30 minutes to attempt 60 situations.

These 60 situations will be flashed on the screen as follows:-

6 situations per slide

Total slides = 10

Responses should be practical and action-oriented.

Write briefly and clearly

Do not write explanations or theories

A timer of 30 minutes will be displayed on the top right corner of the screen

You are allowed to scroll front and back to visit all the situations in this time frame INSTRUCTIONS FOR SRT

SELF DESCRIPTION

In this test, you will be covering the following five paragraphs:- 1.Parents opinion about you? 2.teachers/ Employers opinion about you? 3. friends /Colleagues opinion about you? 4.Your own opinion about yourself? 4.What do you want to become? The total time limit for this test is 15 minutes. INSTRUCTIONS FOR SD
